patchouli.raymovies.recipe_book.landing: Welcome to the Devil Contract mod! This book contains the recipe for the Boosted Gear.
category.raymovies.recipes.desc: Crafting recipes for Devil Contract items
entry.raymovies.boosted_gear.title: Boosted Gear
entry.raymovies.boosted_gear.page1: The $(6)Boosted Gear$() is a powerful weapon from the anime $(o)High School DxD$().$(br2)It belongs to Issei Hyoudou and contains the soul of the Red Dragon Emperor, Ddraig.
entry.raymovies.boosted_gear.page2: Craft the Boosted Gear using this pattern:$(br2)$(6)R$() = Redstone Block$(br)$(2)E$() = Emerald Block$(br)$(5)S$() = Nether Star$(br)$(6)G$() = Gold Block$(br2)$(7)R E R$(br)$(7)R S R$(br)$(7)R G R
entry.raymovies.boosted_gear.page3: Press $(6)V$() to Boost!$(br2)Each stack increases your damage by +4 (max 10).$(br2)Left-click attacks reach 4.5 blocks.$(br2)$(6)Right-click$() performs a spear thrust: pierces every enemy in a line and dashes forward, 1s cooldown.$(br2)Press $(6)G$() for Equip Mode to unlock more abilities.
entry.raymovies.green_ball.title: Green Ball
entry.raymovies.green_ball.page1: The $(2)Green Ball$() is a powerful melee weapon.$(br2)Base damage is 2. Press $(6)V$() to activate boost.
entry.raymovies.green_ball.page2: Each boost adds +3 attack damage, up to 5 layers (+15).$(br2)Hitting an enemy consumes one boost layer.
